verified.note: Identity only. A US retail receipt never carries the buyer's tax ID — what actually changes hands at a counter is a state resale or exemption certificate, which is a per-state document the SELLER keeps on file. That is deliberately out of scope for now; the certificateProfile slot below is reserved and unused.

note.en: Format only, on purpose. The IRS campus prefix list has changed repeatedly and is not published as a stable machine-readable set, so validating against a copy of it would reject legitimate numbers.
note.es: Solo formato, a propósito. La lista de prefijos del IRS ha cambiado varias veces y no se publica de forma estable, así que validarla rechazaría números legítimos.

reason.en: This app will not store an SSN. It is the single most damaging number to lose, it is not what a counter needs, and an EIN does the same job for every business purpose. Use the EIN.
reason.es: Esta app no guarda un SSN. Es el número más dañino que se puede perder, no es lo que pide un mostrador, y el EIN cumple la misma función para cualquier fin empresarial. Usa el EIN.

note.en: No e-invoicing mandate and no buyer tax ID on retail receipts. What changes hands at a counter is a state exemption certificate, if anything.
note.es: Sin obligación de factura electrónica ni identificación fiscal del comprador en recibos. Lo que se entrega en mostrador, si acaso, es un certificado estatal de exención.
